name: Hanazawa Naito
source:
A gentle and kind hacker detective.

He has a secret about his origins,
and cares for his allies,
but shows no mercy to his enemies.

He has a habit of fiddling with puzzle cubes.

He can't sleep when people are around.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/naito]Official site[/url]]
